question: Two men set out at the same time to walk towards each other from points $A$ and $B$, 72 km apart. The first man walks at the rate of 4 km per hour. The second man walks 2 km the first hour, $2\frac12$ km the second hour, 3 km the third hour, and so on. Then the men will meet
